method_note: Base year of the 2024-based projections: ONS mid-2024 population estimate. ONS: Children under 16, working age, and pensionable age populations are based on State Pension Age (SPA) for a given year. Women's SPA increased to 65 between April 2016 and November 2018. From December 2018, the SPA for both sexes increased to 66 by October 2020 (Pensions Act 2011). Between 2026 and 2028, the SPA will increase from 66 to 67 years for both sexes (Pensions Act 2014), and will increase to 68 between 2044 and 2046 (Pensions Act 2007).
